About

A durian farm built around one simple pleasure: tasting the fruit where it grows.

Durian City Farm is a Malaysian durian farm and agro-tourism destination in Bandar Seri Alam, Johor Bahru. Guests taste our signature durians, grown with organic fertilisers, walk the farm with the people who tend it, learn how durian is farmed and gather for private events.

Durian seasons

Fresh from our trees four times a year.

Our main harvests are usually in December, March, June and September. Timing can shift with the weather, so message us to check what’s ready.
